first_win.era: Drop each winner into the decade of their first Ballon d'Or win.
first_win.shot: In what year did {label} first win the Ballon d'Or?

rows.label: Lionel Messi
rows.hook: is often called the best player of his generation, weaving past defenders before finally lifting the World Cup

rows.label: Cristiano Ronaldo
rows.hook: is renowned for explosive speed, aerial power and a trademark leaping celebration after nearly every goal

rows.label: Rodri
rows.hook: anchored a treble-winning midfield with calm passing rather than flashy runs

rows.label: Ronaldinho
rows.hook: dazzled fans with no-look passes, flip flaps and a permanent smile on the pitch

rows.label: Michael Owen
rows.hook: shot to fame as a teenager with a blistering solo goal at a World Cup

rows.label: Karim Benzema
rows.hook: spent years finishing off moves for a star-studded club before finally being crowned the world's best

rows.label: Ronaldo
rows.hook: terrorized defenses with explosive pace before a serious knee injury nearly ended his career

rows.label: Zinedine Zidane
rows.description: French association football player and coach
rows.hook: is remembered for an outrageous volley in one final and a stunning headbutt in another

rows.label: Luka Modrić
rows.hook: controls midfield with effortless passing for both his club and country deep into his thirties

rows.label: Kevin Keegan
rows.description: English association football player and manager (1951–2026)
rows.hook: brought flair and permed hair to the domestic top flight before managing the national team

rows.label: Ousmane Dembélé
rows.hook: exploded onto the scene with blistering pace before helping his club win a historic treble

rows.label: Johan Cruyff
rows.hook: revolutionized attacking play with a feinting turn that wrong-footed defenders for a decade

rows.label: Kaká
rows.hook: glided past opponents with long strides before a string of injuries slowed his career

rows.label: Ruud Gullit
rows.description: Dutch association football player and manager
rows.hook: wore his hair in dreadlocks and led a golden generation to their country's only major trophy

rows.label: Luís Figo
rows.hook: sparked outrage by swapping one fierce rival club for another at the peak of his career

rows.label: Marco van Basten
rows.description: Dutch association football player and manager (born 1964)
rows.hook: scored a stunning volley from an impossible angle in a European final

rows.label: Andriy Shevchenko
rows.hook: led the league in goals for years before a big-money move to England never quite clicked

rows.label: Rivaldo
rows.hook: scored spectacular overhead kicks and helped lift a fifth World Cup

rows.label: Bobby Charlton
rows.description: English association football player and manager (1937–2023)
rows.hook: survived a plane crash early in his career and went on to help win a World Cup at home

rows.label: Alfredo Di Stéfano
rows.hook: dominated a golden era of European football, scoring in five straight continental finals

rows.label: Roberto Baggio
rows.hook: is remembered for a ponytail, a missed penalty in a World Cup final, and years of clutch goals

rows.label: Fabio Cannavaro
rows.description: Italian association football player and manager
rows.hook: anchored a rock-solid defense that lifted a World Cup without conceding in the knockout rounds

rows.label: Karl-Heinz Rummenigge
rows.description: German football executive and former football player
rows.hook: led a national team to back-to-back World Cup finals while playing through persistent knee problems

rows.label: Pavel Nedvěd
rows.hook: ran tirelessly up and down the wing and helped his club complete a treble in the same remarkable season

rows.label: Michel Platini
rows.description: French football player, manager and executive (born 1955)
rows.hook: scored freely from free kicks and open play to lead his country to a home continental championship

rows.label: Hristo Stoichkov
rows.hook: combined a fiery temper with a lethal left foot to lead his country to a World Cup semifinal

rows.label: Matthias Sammer
rows.description: German association football player, coach and executive (born 1967)
rows.hook: redefined the sweeper role by charging forward into attack and captaining his side to continental glory
